mapper.select: SELECT identity.user_id, credential.password_verifier FROM auth_identity identity JOIN local_password_credential credential ON credential.auth_identity_id = identity.id WHERE identity.provider = 'LOCAL_EMAIL' AND identity.provider_subject = #{normalizedEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
INSERT INTO app_user DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING id
INSERT INTO auth_identity (user_id, provider, provider_subject) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, 'LOCAL_EMAIL', #{normalizedEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_password_credential (auth_identity_id, password_verifier) VALUES (#{identityId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{encodedPasswordHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO app_access_grant (user_id, app_code) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, 'LANGUAGE')
